purpose: Retain all retrospective suggestions without claiming unrun experiments or altering issued forecasts/models.

records.event: Hapoel Tel Aviv vs Real Madrid
records.hypothesis_and_acceptance: Prospectively test whether forecast margin and total need separate rotation/pace scenarios in high-scoring comeback games. Before future games lock both scenario probabilities and use identical endpoints; compare paired proper scores against the unchanged model on a preregistered holdout, with event-clustered uncertainty. Accept only improvement whose confidence interval excludes zero and whose calibration does not deteriorate; this game is excluded from that test.
records.remaining_requirement: A separately preregistered protocol, independent evidence and prospective/chronological test; recorded acceptance before promotion.

records.event: Grand Rapids Griffins at Cleveland Monsters
records.hypothesis_and_acceptance: For a prospective AHL sample, lock goalie confirmation and special-teams exposure before issuance and test a separate empty-net tail against a model that omits it. Use event-level paired log loss/Brier on identical full-game totals, with sample size fixed by power analysis before collection. Accept only a positive held-out improvement with confidence interval excluding zero; do not train on this retrospectively imported result.
records.remaining_requirement: A separately preregistered protocol, independent evidence and prospective/chronological test; recorded acceptance before promotion.

records.event: Philadelphia Flyers at New Jersey Devils
records.hypothesis_and_acceptance: On future NHL cards lock distinct regulation and full-game IDs/endpoints and goalie evidence before cutoff. Test a regulation draw component plus conditional OT winner model against a single winner model, using the same predeclared games and paired proper scores. Accept only held-out improvement with event-clustered confidence interval above zero and endpoint audit completeness of 100%; this game supplies a diagnostic example only.
records.remaining_requirement: A separately preregistered protocol, independent evidence and prospective/chronological test; recorded acceptance before promotion.

records.event: Philadelphia Phillies at Atlanta Braves, Wild Card Game 3
records.hypothesis_and_acceptance: Prospectively separate opener/bulk-pitcher workload from named-starter identity and require measured wind direction before applying weather adjustments. Lock p_model and p_card on identical full-game rows. On a preregistered held-out sample accept the added features only if paired proper-score improvement has confidence interval above zero and no timing/identity failures; this late imported card is excluded.
records.remaining_requirement: A separately preregistered protocol, independent evidence and prospective/chronological test; recorded acceptance before promotion.

records.event: Indiana Fever at Las Vegas Aces, First Round Game 3
records.hypothesis_and_acceptance: Prospectively lock a joint team-score/margin distribution and actual starting-unit confirmation rather than treating recent totals and underdog covers as independent support. Test the closing-separation and one-team-scoring-floor features on a preregistered holdout against the unchanged baseline; require improved event-level proper scores with confidence interval above zero and stable margin/total calibration. Do not use this late card for performance estimation.
records.remaining_requirement: A separately preregistered protocol, independent evidence and prospective/chronological test; recorded acceptance before promotion.

records.hypothesis_and_acceptance: In a future preregistered NBL shadow cohort test team-level free-throw conversion and offensive-rebound scenarios separately from pace, with injury availability locked before start. Require held-out paired proper-score improvement versus the unchanged baseline with event-clustered confidence interval excluding zero and unchanged NO_FORECAST eligibility rules. This intake-only event is excluded from live-card performance.
records.remaining_requirement: A separately preregistered protocol, independent evidence and prospective/chronological test; recorded acceptance before promotion.

records.hypothesis_and_acceptance: Prospectively lock supplied-contract IDs before ranking and model regulation late-inning tie-state scoring separately from extra innings. Compare the added late-run component to unchanged totals on a preregistered KBO holdout, using identical endpoints and event-level proper scores. Accept only improvement with confidence interval excluding zero plus 100% supplied-to-ranked contract matching; this retrospective event is excluded.
records.remaining_requirement: A separately preregistered protocol, independent evidence and prospective/chronological test; recorded acceptance before promotion.

records.event: Sydney Roosters vs Newcastle Knights, Grand Final
records.hypothesis_and_acceptance: Prospectively estimate separate outright-win and cover probabilities, with late-score branches, for knockout rugby league. Lock all gapped thresholds and compare a joint margin/total model to the unchanged baseline on a preregistered holdout. Accept only improved event-level proper scores with confidence interval above zero and no deterioration in threshold calibration; do not derive a finals or hooker-change penalty from this single game.
records.remaining_requirement: A separately preregistered protocol, independent evidence and prospective/chronological test; recorded acceptance before promotion.

records.hypothesis_and_acceptance: Prospectively test a remaining-rotation usage/depth feature versus a uniform injury penalty for heavy favourites, with confirmed minute expectations before cutoff. Use a preregistered holdout and paired margin/total proper scores at all frozen thresholds. Accept only improvement with confidence interval above zero and no loss of tail calibration; this game cannot establish a universal 'injuries do not matter' rule.
records.remaining_requirement: A separately preregistered protocol, independent evidence and prospective/chronological test; recorded acceptance before promotion.

records.event: Bayern Munich vs EWE Baskets Oldenburg
records.hypothesis_and_acceptance: Prospectively lock actual available rotation and elapsed rest hours, then test asymmetric team-score tails against a model using only combined-total averages. Compare identical frozen endpoints on a preregistered holdout with event-clustered proper-score intervals. Accept only improvement whose interval excludes zero and perfect pregame timestamp compliance; exclude this late imported card from the test.
records.remaining_requirement: A separately preregistered protocol, independent evidence and prospective/chronological test; recorded acceptance before promotion.

records.event: Kyrgyzstan vs Lebanon, senior international friendly
records.hypothesis_and_acceptance: Before future first-half or corners rows, require two correctly identified phase/provider records including an admitted authoritative phase field and explicit disagreement handling. Test the phase adapter on a fixed validation corpus with 100% period/extra-time identity matches and no unresolved conflicts silently graded. Only then conduct a preregistered forecast holdout with paired proper scores; this disputed phase must not enter training or performance scoring.
records.remaining_requirement: A separately preregistered protocol, independent evidence and prospective/chronological test; recorded acceptance before promotion.
